records.subject: spec-guard-codex-cli-handoff
evidence: command:codex exec --skip-git-repo-check -c model_reasoning_effort=low 'spec-guard handoff' (in a temporary activated project, installed plugin, no trust bypass)
result:the run printed `hook: UserPromptSubmit Blocked` and no model output or `tokens used` line: the prompt never reached the model
result:`codex exec` does not print the block reason, so the handoff text itself is not visible in exec mode

records.reason: whether the Codex TUI shows the block reason (the handoff text) to the user is not observed: exec mode prints only the Blocked status, and the TUI run needs the user to type the trigger once.
